lines.text: Tyre gloats over ruined Jerusalem, so the Lord GOD says He is against Tyre and will raise up many nations.
The nations will destroy Tyre's walls and towers, make her a bare rock, and she will become a place to spread nets.
God will bring Sennacherib king of Assyria from the north against Tyre, with horses, chariots, siege works and battering rams.
His horses will trample the streets, the stones and timber will be thrown into the valley, and Tyre's songs will be silenced.
The princes of the sea will lament Tyre, and God will cover her with mighty waters until she is no more.
